Name: (CP) cantabileChaos Unicorns for 1.6
Author: Meggiee
Description:
I have converted (with permission) cantabileChaos's cute Unicorn mod to Content Patcher, since BFAV is now obsolete.
All credits go to @cantabileChaos for the original mod and art.
To install, simply make sure you have both SMAPI and Content Patcher updated, then drop the unzipped mod into your Mods folder.

There was a possible photosensitivity issue in the original mod, and I haven't been able to recreate it on my game, but just in case, I'm copying over the warning.

PHOTOSENSITIVITY WARNING: One of the current glitches I've experienced with the mod is that the colors on the magic sunflowers can sometimes
blink in and out rapidly. Please exercise caution if something like this could be dangerous for you!
